results.text: Comparative Study of the Effects of Clonidine and Tranexamic Acid on Intraoperative Bleeding in Rhinoplasty: A Clinical Trial. The present study was conducted to compare the effects of clonidine and tranexamic acid on the volume of bleeding and quality of the surgical field in terms of bleeding in candidates who underwent rhinoplasty.
